name: Cá cháy
summary: Cá cháy is its own fish plate in the daily rice, set between the fried fish and the grilled dried fish, and the spice stays light.
origin: Cham Islands. The daily catch on Tân Hiệp, eaten with rice.
howToEat: With rice, at the midday or evening meal. Lunch is about 11:00–12:00 and the evening meal about 17:00–18:00.
where: Bai Lang and the other hamlets.
seoTitle: Cá cháy — a daily fish plate, Cham Islands
seoDescription: Cá cháy is a daily fish plate on Tân Hiệp, named apart from fried fish and grilled dried fish.
